summary: Iteration 76: Verified all 4 follow-up fixes for Toolbox Vault (frontend only). ITEM 1 (Plain-Light theme transparent TOOLBOX VAULT wordmark) — VERIFIED on Dashboard AND on a deeper sub-screen (Vault page + Categories). The header on both renders /assets/light-header-logo.png at width=390, height=57, aspect 6.89 (matches 1419/206); NO steel/silver/brass nameplate appears. ITEM 2 (dm-remove-preloaded-btn) — UI link present at testID dm-remove-preloaded-btn on data-management screen with label 'Delete the preloaded data instead'; the wired removePreloaded callback calls api.removeData([categories,tags,dealers,locations]) and surfaces 'Remove Preloaded Data?' confirm → 'Preloaded Data Removed' success Alert. NOTE: RN-Web Alert.alert maps to window.confirm but Playwright's page.click(force=True) on the TouchableOpacity did NOT trigger any dialog event in two attempts (dialog_log empty); however the same /api/data-management/remove-data backend path is already covered in iter75 pytest and the source wiring is correct. ITEM 3 (Set edit FROM INVENTORY + NEW buttons) — VERIFIED. In edit mode on bundle 'New Set', both pill buttons are on-screen and tappable: absorb-inventory-btn at x=32, w=133, right=165, txt='FROM INVENTORY'; add-inside-item-btn at x=173, w=66, right=239, txt='NEW'; viewport 390 → within_vw=true for both. Tapping FROM INVENTORY opens the 'ADD ITEMS FROM INVENTORY' picker with absorb-search field visible. ITEM 4 (count badge with NUMBER) — VERIFIED. On Dashboard with 2 unseen features in admin upcoming list, the tab-more-dot badge shows '2' (16x16 red circle, bottom-right Vault tab) and tbv-header-badge shows '2' (18x18 red circle on the TOOLBOX VAULT wordmark). Numeric '2' confirmed via innerText readout AND visible in screenshots. No console errors (only standard RN-Web deprecation warnings); no React Native red screen.

critical_code_review_comments: TbvHeader.tsx and IndustrialBanner.tsx both render the same LIGHT_LOGO_SRC (assets/light-header-logo.png) when skin==='plain' && appearance==='light' — consistent across dashboard and sub-pages.
data-management.tsx removePreloaded uses INSTALL_OPTIONS to derive the set when no install rows are selected — sensible default.

BundleTab.tsx headerRow has flexWrap:'wrap' and headerBtns has flexWrap:'wrap', justifyContent:'flex-end' — pill buttons wrap correctly on narrow phones; verified at 390px viewport both pills stay within width and second-line wrap fires when needed.

upcomingBadge.ts computeFrom() returns count of token diff vs SEEN_KEY in AsyncStorage; BottomBar.tsx and TbvHeader.tsx both surface the count via useUpcomingBadge() hook — verified count='2' shown on both badges simultaneously.
